after.content:
name: ji-relay
services:
  relay:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: deploy/relay/Relay.Dockerfile
    environment:
      JI_RELAY_BIND: 0.0.0.0
      JI_RELAY_PORT: 18090
      JI_RELAY_DATA_DIR: /var/lib/ji-relay
      JI_RELAY_TERMINAL_BOOTSTRAP_FILE: /run/secrets/relay_terminal_bootstrap
    expose:
      - "18090"
      - "18091"
    volumes:
      - ${JI_RELAY_DATA_DIR:-./data}:/var/lib/ji-relay
    secrets:
      - relay_terminal_bootstrap
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=64m,mode=1777
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/opt/ji-relay/bin/healthcheck"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s
  web:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: deploy/relay/Web.Dockerfile
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /var/cache/nginx:size=16m
      - /var/run:size=1m
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    expose:
      - "8080"
    restart: unless-stopped
  ingress:
    image: caddy:2.10.2-alpine
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:18090:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /data:size=32m
      - /config:size=8m
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    depends_on:
      relay:
        condition: service_healthy
      web:
        condition: service_started
    restart: unless-stopped
secrets:
  relay_terminal_bootstrap:
    file: ${JI_RELAY_BOOTSTRAP_FILE:?set JI_RELAY_BOOTSTRAP_FILE to a repository-external 0400/0600 file}
